lines.text: Many learners say: I will travel with the bus.
Better: I will travel by bus.
By! We go to school by car.

data.wrong: I will travel with the bus.

en.hook: Do you say “I will travel with the bus”?
en.tip: For transport we say by: “I will travel by bus.” not “I will travel with the bus.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I will travel with the bus.” 😅 For transport we say by, so the right sentence is “I will travel by bus.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
